goal: Add the PCM stream pipe to asr/server. POST /api/v1/stream (or the path named in OpenAPI) accepts 16 kHz mono PCM (application/octet-stream or audio/L16) and responds application/x-ndjson lines {text, t0, t1, final}. Windowed TDT: buffer N-second windows (default 4s) and call the existing sidecar transcribe RPC per window; last event final:true after request body ends (half-close). v1 clients are non-browser. List the operation in app.doc31 so GET /.well-known/openapi.json includes it. bun test: spec lists /stream; a fake sidecar yields two NDJSON events then final. Do not edit asr/engine. Cite openspec/changes/add-parakeet-stream and add-parakeet-api Audio stream pipe.
